WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ili.product_price IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN ili.product_price / ili.derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.order_item_id) as ili_count
  FROM Order_Items oi 
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as final_avg_of_ratios,
  AVG(ili_count) as final_avg_of_counts
FROM step1
